title: check ubuntu version
linkedin:
> Run `cat /etc/os-release`.

It works on every modern Linux distribution, needs nothing installed, and shows the version number and the codename together. `lsb_release -a` gives friendlier output but depends on a package that minimal images often omit. Do not use `uname -r` for this, because that reports the kernel version, which is a different number entirely.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/check-ubuntu-version/
